title: Seq2Seq with attention

paper.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Seq2Seq with attention: translate deterministic generated date strings with encoder-decoder additive attention; aspirational exact match 0.95. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use generated-dates; required output: Date-token sequences -> decoded date-token sequences. Evaluate exact_match (maximize). Split unique underlying dates before formatting; exact full-string match. Required ablation: Remove attention while keeping encoder decoder and date splits fixed. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
